promoted.scope: QNN custom HMX W8A16 op vs QNN Native HTP, same hardware, 7 Python generated cases

evidence.sidecar_source: generated: recovered W8A16 drain/control plus generated effective-bias fields
evidence.root_cause_note: W8A16 drain scale is QNN's normalized two-stage float32 path: weight_scale/max(weight_scale), then max(weight_scale)*act_scale/output_scale. Direct per-channel scale caused 0/1/2 ULP control mismatches.

evidence.root_cause_note: W4A16 per-channel uses the same normalized two-stage A16 drain scale path as W8A16; fixed A16 constants only matched effective fields and left control/drain bytes wrong.
